pre_outcome_record: No dated preregistration, OSF record, or repository commit predating the GossipCop predictions is available.
evidential_status: secondary external evidence; not presented as prospectively frozen or confirmatory
target_construct: prediction of binary corpus labels from normalized title text; not claim-level factual verification
reference_baseline: always predict the external majority class; balanced accuracy is 0.5
cleaning: shared title normalization; remove empty titles; remove exact same-label duplicates; exclude cleaned titles that retain conflicting labels
overlap_audit: count exact cleaned-title overlap with ISOT and between the two external subsets
uncertainty: 2000 stratified bootstrap resamples preserving fake and real class sizes
implemented_workflow_separation: no model ranking used to redefine the main reported metric
interpretation_limit: The code documents operational separation from GossipCop fitting and selection, but it does not prove preregistration or pre-outcome freezing.
